_comment: AI 生成资源清单。gen_image.py 读取此文件；cutout.py 按 kind 做后处理。prompt 末尾会自动追加 style_suffix[kind] 与 style_suffix[common_<kind>]（无则 common）。带 source 的条目不调用 API，由 cutout.py 从源图裁切。kind: units=棋盘 Q 版精灵；illustrations=正常头身立绘；portraits=头像；backgrounds/props/ui。

style_suffix.common: dark fantasy, western occultism and alchemy, restrained flesh-and-bone body horror, painterly oil texture, muted palette of dark crimson (#7A1E2B), violet-black (#2A1430) and bone white (#E8DCC4), soft rim light, high detail, no text, no watermark, no signature
style_suffix.units: chibi super-deformed game sprite, about 2.5 heads tall, big head, large expressive eyes, small compact body, bold readable silhouette, three-quarter front view facing slightly right, full body with feet visible, centered, isolated on a genuinely transparent background, native alpha channel, no ground shadow
style_suffix.props: single object, three-quarter top-down view from about 60 degrees, centered, isolated on a genuinely transparent background, native alpha channel, no ground shadow
style_suffix.portraits: bust portrait, facing slightly left, dramatic rim light, dark atmospheric background
style_suffix.backgrounds: empty terrain seen from directly above at a slight angle, no characters, no creatures, evenly lit so a grid can be drawn over it, no UI, no text
style_suffix.common_units: dark fantasy, western occultism and alchemy, restrained flesh-and-bone horror kept cute-but-unsettling, clean cel-shaded anime game art with subtle painterly shading, crisp outlines, muted palette of dark crimson (#7A1E2B), violet-black (#2A1430) and bone white (#E8DCC4), high detail, no text, no watermark, no signature
style_suffix.illustrations: full body standing character illustration, normal anatomical proportions about seven heads tall, anime-influenced dark fantasy game character art, detailed costume, facing slightly right, feet visible, centered, isolated on a genuinely transparent background, native alpha channel, no ground shadow
